purpose: Audit whether the current 2.864% ATR OOD cap is biased by being estimated only from date/session contexts in which min95 Consensus selected a trade.

reference_population.unit: one distinct eligible date/session context = one vote
reference_population.statistic: market_median_atr = median ATR14_pct across all eligible candidate rows in that date/session

use_of_current_cap: comparison only; do not force equality and do not tune full-context quantile to match outcomes
decision_contract: This run is distribution-only and cannot promote or reject Consensus.
Do not replace the frozen 2.864 cap merely because the full-context q90 differs.
If V44 fails, retain V45 only as diagnostic evidence and do not rescue Consensus by changing the ATR cap.
If V44 passes, preregister a separate pre-2026 validation of the outcome-free full-context q90 before considering it as ATR reference v2.
